notes.title: v2.0 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
In order to provide a better gaming experience, we have released Sword & Fairy 7 Ver. 2.0 (In-game version number) today, which will address the following issues.
 
Update content is as follows:
1.Oodle Compression Algorithm has been employed to re-compress the client, reducing the client package size. Therefore, the hard drive capacity usage has been reduced; thus, the loading time in-game is also reduced. [New game file size should be reduced from 69.9G to 30.6G]

2.Optimized and reduced the memory and display memory usage in-game.

3.Optimized the level streaming and PSO for the scenes, effectively improving and stabilizing the frame rate and reducing stuttering in-game.

4.Added a “Hardware Load” performance reminder in Graphic settings, offering reference for players when adjusting the Graphic settings.

5.Fixed the stuttering mouse movement issues in some cases.

6.Removed the manual confirmation step for changing scenes while flying.

7.Fix the disappearance bug of XiuWu's weapons "Mineral" and "Mineral(R)".

Special Explanation:
1.There are no changes to in-game content. Players who have already cleared the game or otherwise have no desire to update the game can ignore this update.

2.For those who do desire this update, please uninstall the game, then re-download and install the new version.

3.We strongly recommend that you backup your existing game files before updating.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/2cdbaad3f475214efda8519e60e679a0005b64d3.jpg[/img]

notes.title: v2.0 UPDATE FORECAST
notes.notes:
Announcement:

Sword and Fairy 7 PC version Special Update Announcement & Explanation

In order to provide an even better gaming experience, version 2.0 for Sword and Fairy 7 PC version will be released on Dec. 8, 2022. In order to provide a smooth transition, we have provided the following update explanation:

1.This update mainly tackles the performance issues of the game. There are no changes to the in-game content.

2.Thanks to a more efficient software packaging system, the size of the game client will be reduced to 30GB.

3.Implemented the latest hard disk reading method to shorten loading and waiting times during gameplay.

4.Game performance has been optimized to provide a more stable frame rate and better smoothness in gameplay.

	Due to the fact that these optimizations are quite extensive, all game files will need to be updated (Total 30GB). In order to minimize any inconveniences, we recommend the following:

1.There are no changes to in-game content. Players who had already cleared the game or otherwise have no desire to update the game can ignore this update.

2.For players who do desire this update, we recommend that you do a clean install by uninstalling the previous version of this game, then redownloading and installing the new version. 

3.We strongly recommend that you make a local or cloud-based backup of your existing game files before updating.

We thank you for your continuing support, and we will strive to continue to  optimize and improve the game experience.

The Sword and Fairy Development Team

notes.title: Китайский гость: Обзор Sword and Fairy 7
notes.notes: Восточная волна с некоторой неуверенностью и опозданием штурмует западные рынки, так что многие проекты лишь спустя годы славы добираются и до нас. В прошлом году я писал про серию Xuan-Yuan Sword и ее седьмую часть. В этом году очередь дошла до Sword and Fairy 7. И снова седьмая часть. Мистика цифр. Франшиза с тридцатилетней историей от небольшой студии из Пекина смогла совершить рывок от пошаговой ролевой истории до технологичного приключения с элементами экшена.

notes.title: Always be there Sword and Fairy 7 Launches Today
notes.notes:
The PC standalone game, Sword and Fairy 7 which is the 9th sequel to the series officially launches today!
Sword and Fairy 7 is an action RPG, developed by Softstar Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. Its digital version is sold at the price of $29.99, officially unlocks on Oct. 22 2021.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/1649e8d455f30fa2ed9c3e23c3c62214a423a3d7.jpg[/img]

[previewyoutube=NrgAL9u2sp0;full][/previewyoutube]

“Sword and Fairy 7” is a whole new story based on the Sword and Fairy world concept with new characters. The game has a bound to its previous episodes, however, it is complete and independent, quite friendly to new players.

This game starts with the story among three clans “Human”, “Deity”, and “Demon”, it brings rich story-lines as well as improves the battle system compared with its previous episodes. Third person real-time action mode is being used to bring the players smooth combat experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/b409fc423f7fac5e091fb7c3d0bc1568311a57c3.jpg[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/ff1ea59861a6a5c345c24630f5cea284e96098ff.jpg[/img]

Sword and Fairy 7 has a deep cooperation with NVIDIA. The game supports NVIDIA DLSS (Deep Learning Super Sampling) and Ray Tracing technology. It will bring a better gaming experience to the players.

Other than its previous episodes, this time, real-time fight is adopted, players can enter the battle anytime with no cut scenes, characters can be switched anytime as players wish. Learning various skills and summoning gods for combat are super helpful, given that those skills can be used wisely, you will rock the battle.

About Sword and Fairy 7
Sword and Fairy series is a smash hit of Chinese standalone RPG. Its first episode was released in 1995, and following with other 8 episodes in succession, helping the series become the icon of Chinese RPG. Sword and Fairy 7 is the 9th sequel to the series, developed by Softstar Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd and based on UE4. Its producer is Yao Zhuangxian who is also known as “Father of Sword and Fairy”.

notes.title: FAQ of Sword and Fairy 7
notes.notes:
[h3]Never played any previous episode of Sword and Fairy, and never played any real time action game either, can I play Sword and Fairy 7 and understand the story well?[/h3]
All the Sword and Fairy episodes can be played separately, there is no understanding obstacles, each episode is an independent story.
According to the play progress, there will be a help or guide info popping up on the right side of the screen, of course you can check the that information in the “Help” section.

[h3]What is the official system requirements for this game?[/h3]
Please check this link below:
https://steamcommunity.com/app/1543030/discussions/0/3114795024893693192/

[h3]Why does the game crash during playing?[/h3]
The game supports the latest Ray Tracing, probably your Windows hasn't been up to date, doesn't have the necessary component DXR1.1 for running it. Please update Windows 10 to the 20H or above.

[h3]Which drive for NVIDIA graphic card do I need?[/h3]
Suggest upgrade to 496.13 or above. Upgrade by running the GeForce Experience app or going to the official website of NVIDIA.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/43cfc9ce7640257074ad10c4731b002d296bb8b8.png[/img]

[h3]Why does the game start lagging even my graphic card meets the running requirements?[/h3]
Please check if the independent graphic card is activated. For instance by NVIDIA, go to the “NVIDIA control panel”, click to enter “3D management settings”, click “Preferred graphic processor” and click “NVIDIA high performance graphic processor”.

[h3]Does Sword and Fairy 7 lock the fps?[/h3]
The fps can be either auto matching your displays or manually set in the game. the charts below for more information.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/679547c7010381cfde6fdb2bf3a425492f1c3701.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/e5a4e86466f9ad1da89426d78cadeabc0e9f5be5.jpg[/img]
When you are using a high refresh display, please pay more attention to the heat dissipation, avoid locking fps at 60 by overheated.

[h3]Is Vertical Sync available for Sword and Fairy 7?[/h3]
It can be switch on or off in the settings of the game.

[h3]Why is the full screen display color different from the windowed mode?[/h3]
We found this issue occurs when changing the settings of NVIDIA control panel, please set the settings to default on NVIDIA control panel.

[h3]What OS I need to use for this game? What plug-ins I need to run this game properly?[/h3]
OS needs to be Windows 10 64bit or above.
Plug-ins: [b]Unreal4Launcher    Prerequisite Visual C++    DirectX 11[/b]

[h3]Is it possible to run this game on Windows 7?[/h3]
We already tested this game on Windows 7, a part of players could run this game, but we do not guarantee using windows 7. Windows 10 is our recommended OS for this game, more stable and more reliable.

[h3]How does the data saving work in the game?[/h3]
Except in the CG, battle, you can save the game anytime. This game has auto-saving function in some certain scene, but we always recommend you to save manually, in case you lose the gaming progress.

[h3]Why the game crashes when I start it?[/h3]
In the circumstance that all your software and hardware are both enough for running this game, please check drives for your PC, right click “This PC” - “Manage”. check “Device Manager” to see if there is any question marks or exclamation marks, and update them to the latest.

[h3]Why the game looks blurry even all my hardware requirements meet the needs?[/h3]
Right click the desktop, select “Display settings”, and check if the “Scale and Layout” is set to 100%.

[h3]Lagging and low frames on laptops?[/h3]
1. Plug in power, select "Performace mode" in "Power saving, balance, performance" setting.
2.  Check if you are currently switched to integrated graphics.

[h3]How do I change the resolution in full screen play?[/h3]
This game uses the resolution of your desktop when in full screen play, it cannot be changed, if you want to change it, please change the resolution of your desktop, also if you set “Scale and Layout” in “Display settings”, the resolution will follow the settings of it.

[h3]How do i maximize the effect of Ray Tracing?[/h3]
We highly recommend you to switch on “DLSS” if you are running under 1080P and Ray Tracing on. It can optimize the ram of GPU max, decline the chances of game crash.
Recommended settings of DLSS:
Resolution: Below 1920*1080 Level: Off
Resolution: 1920*1080 - 2560*1440 Level: Quality
Resolution: 2560*1440 - 3840*2160 Level: Performance
Resolution: Above 3840*2160 Level: Ultra Performance

How does it perform when switching ON/OFF DLSS?
Please check the official testing data chart below:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/3e110d924dce7abf07ea160057a9c84801004c3e.png[/img]

[h3]What should I do if I have a black screen during playing the game?[/h3]
In your library, right click "Sword and Fairy 7", and select "Properties".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/d15f0d42dd271dfc7e62b1ca059f05bc75df6618.png[/img]
Click “LOCAL FILES” and select "Verify integraty of game files..."
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/980f60796f4ea1fd6e3f65cbc08c085486601268.png[/img]
After all this, black screen issue could be solved.

notes.title: The Heaven Demon Kingdom
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/ae1803850f1f838cc83f79032c4cb02b8e2c7371.jpg[/img]
The vast Nine Mysterious Regions is desolate, filled with a dense and fierce aura. In a corner of the Devildom, on top of a volcano, and over a huge volcanic rock that looks like a blossoming equinox flower, sits the Heaven Demon Kingdom, one of the eight divisions of the Devildom. The Kingdom is built in the concept of a phoenix, and along the long corridor, a phoenix made of strange spiritual stones stands in the center of the Kingdom, ready to fly. At the end is a magnificent palace, which is the Heaven Demon Palace, the palace of the Heaven Witch.

The Heaven Witch Kui Yu was once the general of the Protoss, and with a Loong Cloud Spear, she made a great achievement in the war among the three tribes, and was recognized as the goddess of war. Later, she rebelled against the Protoss and became a witch. Loyal followers entered the Demon Kingdom with her and were called the Demon Kingdom Tribes Heaven Demons.

Unlike other warlike demon races, the Heaven Demons are independent, away from the strife of the demons. Because the fallen demons used to be protoss, they still act with the pride of the protoss; furthermore, because they did not fully gain the trust of the demon races, although they have extraordinary powers, because the number is quite small, it is difficult to deal with the attack of the other demons. That’s why they have kept a low profile.

The Heaven Demon Kingdom is so solemn and silent and you can barely feel time flow in this vast fortress. Its masters have kept silent for too long, perhaps its a way survival, perhaps they are brewing a deeper storm.

notes.title: Introduction of the Mingshu Sect and the Tianshi Sect
notes.notes:
In the trial version of "Sword and Fairy 7", we have known that the heroine Yue Qingshu came from the declining cultivation sect Mingshu Sect, which lived next to a large sect Tianshi Sect. Now between the two sects which are seemingly disparate, there was indeed an unknown past.

[h1][b]Mingshu Sect[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/db7c60ec2b680df4afcb2ab1221539638c86dcb1.jpg[/img]

The Mingshu Sect is located in the Luojia Hills and is a sect that focuses on the spirit beast controlling art. The art was created by its ancestor, which is to share the spiritual power with the immortal spirit beasts, and is a huge test of the disciples' cultivation talent. If a disciple doesn’t have enough talent, he would not be able to cooperate with spirit beasts. In addition, the ancestor also handed down the Mingshu sword art, which is a light and flexible body technique, and the spirit beast controlling art.  The two techniques complement each other, were once famous for a while.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/3de6b8a41e91c07d4d5b5b4452bf0721cb053896.jpg[/img]

The building of the Mingshu Sect is small in scale, covered by bamboo forest, green tiles and red walls, quiet and elegant. A stone platform in the northwest corner is called the Spirit Beast Garden, which is surrounded by hills and water. There is an old plum tree planted in the garden for spirit beasts to rest and cultivate here, and people can enjoy the scenery in their leisure time.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/3653d59703f908710e190b80d90284b5ec1ef499.jpg[/img]

Several generations later, for some unknown reasons, the sect gradually declined, the disciples decreased, and the spirit beast controlling art withered. The current master is a descendant of the founding ancestor, and she aims to revitalize the Mingshu Sect and restore its former glory.

[h1][b]Tianshi Sect[/b][/h1]

The Luojia Hills is a gorgeous place that is suitable for cultivation, thus The ancestor of the Tianshi Sect agreed with his friend to establish a sect here. The ancestors of the Tianshi Sect specialized in fist and palm kung fu, combining magic and physical arts, and increasing his spiritual power with the help of objects containing five spirits, which is known as Spiritual Transformation. The Tianshi Sect believes that as long as there is a desire for the Tao, regardless of how much talent ones have, they can be admitted by the sect. Although the practice progress of Spiritual Transformation is slow, but there are not too many constraints on the practitioner, thus it has absorbed a large number of disciples.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/d3214729b0a0bd239bc95bb1dbb5adfc1a093fad.jpg[/img]

Tianshi Sect is located on the top of the hill. the building layout of the sect follows the eight diagrams of yin and yang, which is deeply in line with the theory of Feng Shui. Through the heavy clouds and fog, that can be vaguely seen green tiles and white walls, the sect's hills protection field and the exquisite four-image sky lantern floating at the eye of the field.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/578f0684c90c35277ce51ce23be147cbf02b6144.jpg[/img]

Several generations later, the Tianshi Sect has become more and more prosperous, and the current master has taken on the aspirations of his ancestors, and has accepted a wide range of disciples, eager for the title of the head of the sect.

notes.title: Emei Wonderland and the Mysterious Miao Village
notes.notes:
In the previously announced trailer, the Xianxia Sect disciple Bai Moqing and the Miao Sect boy Sang You have made their debut, here you will see introduction about their daily life and more background to the story.

Emei Wonderland

Xianxia Sect first appeared in the "Sword and Fairy 2”, which is also the sect of Bai Moqing. She is an adorable little school sister, loved by the entire Xianxia disciples, and also one of the best disciples among the new generation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/b73416da9bdc88db047c516f98c8d200cc52355c.jpg[/img]

The Emei Mountain in Sichuan is full of spiritual energy, with steep hillsides and jagged peaks, dense plants along the mountain roads, waterfalls and mountains in between, the place is soothing and all the seasons here are as warm as spring.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/cd2c29b90bc8a1987ad009038a29438eb4ecfb26.jpg[/img]

The first master, Qing Rou, founded the Xianxia Sect in this area, with the idea of helping the poor and the needy, and she was well known for her kindness. After she retired from her duties, her disciple took over.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/f00c3885095b4e85c7b2d16208a221ed71e4c812.jpg[/img]

The new master has taken the world's orphaned and displaced girls into Xianxia, and has taught them the art of charms and swordsmanship, making Xianxia even more well-known than before. Because all the disciples are women, without permission of the master, men are not allowed to enter. Trepassing or disturbing the rules will be forcibly expelled. (This is also the reason why Sang You frequently encountered the "poisonous" hand of the sisters)


Mysterious Miao Village

The Miao village that appears at the beginning of the video is the hometown of Sang You. How does the Miaojiang boy coming from a hidden secret world meet the little sister, and under what chance does he travel with the other three protagonists? The seemingly cheeky boy not just know how to make gags, but is also a reliable partner at critical moments.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/21f74b0faa8955776c65381f24c3d50a9d156dae.jpg[/img]

Among the remote Miao mountains, there is a mysterious village built around a natural tiankeng. Plants in the village are also nourished by the mysterious spiritual energy and grow much taller than ordinary plants.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/d53750be062ce361048442497f7cca4f76107868.jpg[/img]

Men and women in the village learn to dye and print cloth from an early age, using such a craft to make precious fabrics that are hard to see in the outside world.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/de974ed769eebaf97ee0c3b9a29dd308d147dfb5.jpg[/img]

In addition to their cloth-making skills, people of the village are also good at singing and dancing, and when their important friends arrive, people will lit a bonfire in the center of the village and hold a happy feast.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/e58b290cfd3d13b92d23aaa3288cd9c7899a8fdc.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Sword and Fairy 7 Release RT trailer
notes.notes:
Sword and Fairy 7 is a role-playing game developed by Softstar Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd.
This work balanced the experience of drama and gameplay. The attractive story happens between three races of Humans, Demons and Beasts. Compared with the previous series, combat system has undergone major changes. To ensure the fast pace and fluent controls in the battlefield, this game adopts a real-time combat from a third-person perspective, players may enter and exit the battlefield seamlessly.

In 2019, NVIDIA and Softstar jointly announced that Sword and Fairy 7 will have ray tracing technology in the game, and announced an in-game recorded trailer using ray tracing. After two years of painstaking development, NVIDIA joined hands with Sword and Fairy 7 to bring more RT scenes from the game, showing more types of RT features applicable to different types of maps.

[previewyoutube=lGO6M7joVxM;full][/previewyoutube]

The crystal clear pond not only reflects the whirling reflections of the trees and buildings on the shore, but also shows the sparkling water caustics effect, making the player's ideal fairy world more real. The pool water uses NVIDIA Hybrid Translucency technology, which enhances RT reflection over the water, and makes the reflection effect more realistic than traditional SSR. The caustics effect is calculated in real time using NVIDIA Ray-Guided Water Caustics (RGWC) based on ray tracing, which can make the caustics effect of the water body and the characters interact realistically. The combination of the two technologies produces the now-seeing Sword and Fairy art style gorgeous effect of the pool water, which is difficult to achieve with traditional rendering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/20b238f4c1e2cf31807a9f227712c42599825eac.jpg[/img]

Direct sunlight enters deep seabed caves, RGWC water caustics technology is also used here to reflect the caustic ripples on the reef, making the experience of snorkeling on the seabed more immersive.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/c28a6e251bb82fc9153d901bf78fef2aded4ea3b.jpg[/img]

The light emitted by the scarlet crystal in the cave reflected red on the surrounding cave walls and paths. If you look closely, you will find that the light from the crystal forms a brighter caustic spot on the ground. Unlike water caustics, NVIDIA Adaptive Anisotropic Photon Scattering (AAPS) ray tracing technology is used here. This technology can calculate accurate real-time caustics effects on translucent objects, highlighting the mysterious atmosphere of the cave.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/6f1abb4d7ba7df22d8aca4660d504d4a7736c45c.jpg[/img]

Sunshine goes through the stained glass and reflects on the dim hall, NVIDIA AAPS technology generates mottled color patches on the ground in real time. As the sun moves, not only the entire hall is illuminated, RT global illumination also makes the places in the hall gradually brighter even if there is no direct sunlight. Different from the traditional global illumination, NVIDIA ReSTIR GI technology based on ray tracing is used here. This technology can implement indirect lighting from various light sources and emissive surfaces using a very low sampling rate, therefore producing complex light and shadow effects almost consistent with the real physical world, while maintaining extremely high rendering performance. This is a precise balance of effects and efficiency which is difficult to achieve with traditional rendering.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40102826/ddcf3eae3db90cced8c8c9fbcbf3d44bccae0af5.jpg[/img]

Ray tracing technology is fully applied in the development of Sword and Fairy 7, improves the overall light atmosphere in the game. Softstar is expecting to bring an upgraded new generation of Sword and Fairy artwork.
